question: Which knowledge point is best demonstrated by the dynamic process in the video?

choices.A: Unsupported objects accelerate downward under gravity.

knowledge_point: A solid can absorb heat and melt into a liquid.
question: Which knowledge point is best demonstrated by the dynamic process in the video?

choices.A: A solid can absorb heat and melt into a liquid.
choices.B: A liquid can evaporate when exposed to airflow.
choices.C: A gas can condense into liquid droplets on a cold surface.
choices.D: A dissolved solid can crystallize as solvent evaporates.

dynamic_evidence.description: The solid decreases in size while liquid increases around it over time.
